events.title: Art Exhibition: The Little Pink House and The Golden Garden
events.description: An art exhibition showcasing works by Claire Bear and Sarah Gee at Studio 8 Currumbin, running daily. It features unique artistic creations in a local gallery setting.

events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection of Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: An exhibition at HOTA Gallery featuring highlights from the renowned White Rabbit Collection of contemporary Chinese art. It offers a chance to explore significant works from a major collection.

events.title: Dracula's: Lucid (Dinner & Show)
events.description: A unique dinner and show experience at Dracula's Gold Coast, featuring a performance with a strong atmosphere, live music, and special effects. Expect a theatrical and entertaining evening.

events.title: Flora: Nature's Gift National Botanical Art Exhibition
events.source: Botanical Art Society of Australia (BASA) and Royal Qld Art Society (RQAS)
events.description: A national exhibition of botanical art, showcasing detailed and beautiful depictions of flora. Hosted by RQAS 'Red Wall' Gallery, it provides an opportunity to appreciate nature through art.

events.title: ROGUE TRADERS - THE ANTHEMS - 21ST ANNIVERSARY TOUR
events.description: Rogue Traders perform their hits on their 21st-anniversary tour at Miami Marketta, a popular Gold Coast venue. Expect a lively pop/electronic music concert.

events.title: The Australian Bee Gees Show
events.description: A tribute show celebrating the music of the Bee Gees at The Star Gold Coast. Expect a performance of classic disco and pop hits.

events.title: Yacht Rock Revival
events.description: A live music event celebrating the smooth sounds of 'yacht rock' at the Wallaby Hotel. Expect a nostalgic concert experience with classic hits.

events.title: It's On ChevrON (Street Party)
events.location: Thomas Drive, Chevron Island, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A free community street party on Chevron Island, featuring local entertainment, food, and activities. It's a chance to connect with the local neighbourhood in a festive atmosphere.

events.title: Coast Acoustics Unplugged – OUT of ABINGDON
events.description: An intimate acoustic music performance by "OUT of ABINGDON," hosted by the Coast Acoustic Music Club. Enjoy live folk-style music in a relaxed community setting.

events.title: Surfside Sounds
events.location: Performing Arts Centre, Robina State High School, Robina
events.description: A performance by the Gold Coast City Brass Band at Robina State High School's Performing Arts Centre. This concert offers an afternoon of brass band music for the community.

events.title: Language Exchange at Carrara
events.description: A weekly language exchange session at Carrara, followed by a church community social with free food and coffee. This recurring event is designed for people to practice languages and connect.
